name: Jace
source:
The male protagonist. A self-proclaimed "rational narcissist" because he strongly values honesty and the truth is he's pretty hot. A social butterfly, Jace has breezed through life so far thanks to his good looks and confident charm. Unwilling to date anyone he's not genuinely interested in, Jace never crosses the line past flirting with anyone.
